title: ESPN'S NO.3 PLAYER IN THE WORLD? REAL MADRID REPORTEDLY STILL WANT HIM
description:
No bid, no fee, just a lot of eyes on one Bayern winger.

L'Équipe reports that Real Madrid remain interested in Michael Olise. Let's be clear: it's a rumour, not a bid, and no fee has been reported. He's twenty-four, and ESPN ranks him third in the world. Bronze medal, gold-medal queue.

Several top clubs reportedly want him next summer, when his Bayern deal will have two years left. Two years left is a shop window, and Real are just pressing their noses to the glass.

Where should Olise be playing next: stay at Bayern or move to Real Madrid? One word is enough.
